fields.name: currentCharges
documentation: Number of charges currently available

fields.name: maxCharges
documentation: Max number of charges that can be accumulated

fields.name: cooldownStartTime
documentation: If charge cooldown is active, time at which the most recent charge cooldown began; 0 if cooldown is not active

fields.name: cooldownDuration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds required to generate a charge

fields.name: chargeModRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if recharging is not active (ex: at maximum available charges, start time or duration are zero); True otherwise

fields.name: startTime
documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown; Current time if isEnabled is false

fields.name: duration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.name: isEnabled
documentation: False if cooldown is on hold (ex: some cooldowns only start after an active spell is cancelled); True otherwise

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if cooldown is not active (ex: not enabled, or startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.name: modRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: activeCategory
documentation: Indicates which category is responsible for determining the duration. A nil value indicates the duration was determined through some other logic, e.g. the spell is on hold.

fields.name: timeUntilEndOfStartRecovery
documentation: When this is set it indicates that the spell is in recovery and this is how long it will be until that recovery period is finished

fields.name: isOnGCD
documentation: Whether or not this spell is considered to be on the global cooldown, do not trust this field unless responding to a SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN event

fields.name: startTime
documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown

fields.name: duration
documentation: Cooldown duration in seconds if active; 0 if cooldown is inactive

fields.name: modRate
documentation: Rate at which cooldown UI should update

fields.name: isActive
documentation: False if cooldown is not active (startTime or duration are 0); True otherwise

fields.name: shouldReplaceNormalCooldown
documentation: True if this cooldown should be displayed in-place of the normal action cooldown (ex: the LoC cooldown expires later than the normal cooldown); False otherwise

fields.name: name
documentation: The name or 'power token' for this power type (ex: MANA, FOCUS, etc)

fields.name: cost
documentation: Full cost including optional cost; Optional cost is cost the spell will use but isn't required (ex: Rogue spell might cost 1CP but have optional cost of up to 5 more)

fields.name: minCost
documentation: Cost excluding optional cost; This is min required to cast the spell

fields.name: costPercent
documentation: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource; May be 0 if the cost is simply a flat cost

fields.name: costPerSec
documentation: Cost as a percentage of base maximum resource consumed per second, used by channel spells; May be 0 if cost is simply a flat cost

fields.name: requiredAuraID
documentation: An aura the caster must have for the cost to apply; Usually based on things like active spec or shapeshift form

fields.name: hasRequiredAura
documentation: True if there is a requiredAuraID and the caster currently has that aura; Caster is either the current player or their pet, depending on spell type
